title: On a Borel subset of a coordinate n-plane, an IM orientation is a Borel sign times the coordinate n-vector (parent steps 9-10)
statement: Assume (IMC-b) [the second conjunct of the frozen hypothesis (IMC) of the parent]: for all P, n, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every IMRep R in U and every set E, if U is open and E is Borel then there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' in U with R' representing A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult and R'.orient = R.orient, and (PO) [the exact frozen type of the sibling Submission.cmcdtfr_plane_orientation]: for all P, n, strictly increasing ι : Fin n → Fin P, A ⊆ ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P, linear subspaces Q ⊆ ℝ^P and n-vectors ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n, if a_i = x_i for every a ∈ A and every i ∉ range ι, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q, then either ξ(α) = α(E_ι) for every n-covector α or ξ(α) = −α(E_ι) for every α, where E_ι := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}). Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep in U (IMRep U n), ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing, c ∈ ℝ^P and E ⊆ ℝ^P a Borel set lying in the coordinate plane through c spanned by e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}: a_i = c_i for every a ∈ E and every i ∉ range ι. Then there is a Borel function σ : ℝ^P → ℤ with |σ(x)| ≤ 1 for all x such that, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M ∩ E (i.e. μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ E)-a.e.), ξ(x)(α) = σ(x)·α(E_ι) for every n-covector α.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), StrictMono ι → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = x i) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = -α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (c : Euclid P) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → StrictMono ι → MeasurableSet E → (∀ a ∈ E, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = c i) → ∃ σ : Euclid P → ℤ, Measurable σ ∧ (∀ x, |σ x| ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ E)), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x α = (σ x : ℝ) * α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))
